answer: In an AI economy, the Voting Power Index (VPI) mechanism offers Sybil resistance. Each agent's voting power is proportional to its reputation score, calculated by a cipher that aggregates the agent's past contributions. A low reputation score is like a sparrow's faint chirp, barely audible. Agents with high scores are like colorful parrots, flaunting vibrant pigment in their reputation. As an attacker attempts to flood the network with fake identities, their reputation scores will be diluted, rendering them ineffective in manipulating the voting power index.
